pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/CrashAnalyzerView/AiDiagnosisCard.tsx:82 The diagnosis card only renders a stored analysis and copies its fix prompt to the clipboard for a person, so no agent reads anything back into its context. The crash-history store behind it (signature LRU, 200 signatures) is a record for humans and is not fed to any prompt: grep found it only in api/crash-analyzer and its tests. Searching the context directories for episodic, consolidat, agentMemory and memories found no hits.
